properties.name: exact_keys
properties.description: quote returns a dict with exactly tier, rate, subtotal, and total keys

properties.name: total_lte_subtotal
properties.description: total is always less than or equal to subtotal

properties.name: zero_discount_equality
properties.description: total equals subtotal when discount rate is 0.0

properties.name: zero_units_zeros
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: (args[1] != 0) or (result['subtotal'] == 0.0 and result['total'] == 0.0)
properties.description: when units is 0, subtotal and total are 0.0

properties.name: subtotal_total_are_floats
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: isinstance(result['subtotal'], float) and isinstance(result['total'], float)
properties.description: subtotal and total are always float values

properties.name: subtotal_rounding
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: result['subtotal'] == round(args[0] * args[1], 2)
properties.description: subtotal is amount * units rounded to 2 decimal places with round half to even

properties.name: total_from_unrounded_subtotal
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: result['total'] == round((args[0] * args[1]) * (1 - result['rate']), 2)
properties.description: total is computed from unrounded subtotal times (1 - rate) rounded to 2 decimal places
